dict.string: Every-10-min GitHub-issues AUTO-FIXER for stuinfla/ruvnet-brain (Stuart's mandate: "look for any open issues and fix as soon as they hit"). Runs scripts/issue-fix.mjs, which finds new open issues (state: ~/.claude/ruvnet-brain/issue-watch-state.json, namespaced under "__issueFix" so it can never collide with com.ruvnet.issue-watch's own per-issue SLA-alert keys in the SAME file), spawns ONE bounded headless `claude -p` child per issue inside a disposable git worktree (never the shared live tree, never main), and either pushes an issue-fix/<N> review branch + comments, or posts an honest triage comment — never closes an issue. Concurrency 1 via its own lock file (a fix can run up to 15 minutes, longer than this cadence, so overlapping ticks correctly no-op). Wrapped in job-heartbeat.sh per the house positive-confirmation pattern (see config/scheduled-jobs.json, scripts/nightly-watchdog.mjs) — a crash still leaves a receipt and pages the phone; silence is not health. Runs alongside, and does not replace, com.ruvnet.issue-watch (detection/SLA-alert only).
